label: Beadhive
hints: Beadhive (`bh`) is the integration-plane driver for Beadflow: work is tracked as beads and driven bead-by-bead from assigned to merged. Drive the lifecycle with `bh work` verbs — never with raw `git`, `bd`, or `gh`.
Read before acting: `bh work ready` lists unblocked, dependency-ordered work; `bh work issue <id>` shows one bead; `bh work brief <id>` prints its requirements plus the hive's validation command.

The normal worker loop is `bh work claim <id>` (provisions a worktree and flips the bead to in_progress), edit inside that worktree, `bh work check <id>` (runs the hive's validation), then `bh work submit <id>` (opens the review gate). `submit` is a handoff, not 'done'.
`bh work merge <id>` is the merge owner's step and only works on an approved bead. Never merge a bead whose review gate is unresolved.

An epic is driven as a molecule: `bh work start <epic>` provisions the container branch, `bh work schedule <epic>` prints the dispatch plan, and `bh work finish <epic>` lands the whole molecule as one --no-ff bubble.
`bh hive ready` reports whether a repo is onboarded as a hive; `bh doctor` prints providers, orgs, and warnings.
If a tool problem blocks you, `bh escalate '<msg>'` files it upward and returns immediately — it never blocks your turn.

approvals.reason: Lands a bead on the always-green integration branch. Merging is the merge owner's serialized step and is not cheaply reversible.
Lands an entire assembled molecule up one level as a single --no-ff bubble.
Resolves a bead's HUMAN review gate. An agent must not clear the gate that exists to put a human in the loop on its own work.
Hands the bead to review and, when the gate is out-of-process, pushes the branch to the remote.
The contribution plane writes outbound to an upstream project — issues and changes leave this organization.
Writes the durable central Head Office store shared by the whole fleet.
Rebuilds the hub across every registered hive, cloning and mutating working copies.
Commissions a repository as a hive and writes its config — a one-way setup step.
Changes hive or fleet configuration underneath every other seat.
Irreversibly removes a host from the fleet roster in Head Office. This is an operator action; an agent has no business running it.
